gate_options_backgroundCheckHelp.message:
Off by default.

When on: the extension checks your public IP automatically at the chosen interval, even if no listed site is open. The result applies to every site in the list.

When off: the IP is checked only when you open a listed site.

Note: Firefox may delay automatic checks.

gate_options_domainsHelp.message: Subdomains are covered. Firefox asks for access to each domain.

gate_options_endpointHelp.message: HTTPS only. Must return the public IPv4 as plain text.

gate_options_intervalHelp.message: Seconds between background checks. Firefox uses this interval as-is; the browser can still delay a check while it is busy or asleep.
